advice: Abstain. The supplied full-size kernel has one SME entry/exit around the complete GEMM, and its ZA setup is coupled to the generated assembly’s tile and traversal structure. The supplied panel helper enters and exits SME per call, but its sixteen-call wrapper was already measured in Low Power and Automatic and was not promoted. The other supplied source changes either repeat measured variants or require a new generated primitive. I have no distinct, evidence-grounded streaming-region change to propose within the fixed ABI and scope.
risks: The supplied results do not isolate streaming-state or ZA setup costs, and noisy paired scores do not establish their cause. A new helper or altered SME-region boundary would need generated code not supplied here; proposing it without that code would leave its ABI, ZA lifetime, and correctness unverified. No performance claim is made.
